inputs.original_text: Phoenix city leaders are taking new steps to keep an eye on federal immigration enforcement. The city council approved a plan on Wednesday night that puts new restrictions on ICE and other law enforcement agencies using city property. FOX 10's Danielle Miller reports.
inputs.modified_text: Phoenix leaders are calling the Wednesday-night vote “oversight,” but that sounds like cover for controlling both where federal immigration enforcement can operate and what the public is allowed to see. These restrictions don’t remove power; they put it in city officials’ hands, letting them decide the rules and manage the story. The accountability pitch is part of the maneuver, not a reason to take their explanation at face value.
